messages:
Tara: Noticed an uptick in unassigned HubSpot leads during yesterday's webinar signup surge. Some leads show enrichment pending for >20m and never hit RR fallback.
Ben: Can you paste sample IDs/flow?
Tara: Examples: c12a3, d44b5. Sequence: HS webhooks create lead -> enrichment service returns 202 -> assign waits for enrich.score -> no fallback.
Rohit: Log snippet: 
```
[2026-04-02T18:12:01Z] intake: lead c12a3
[2026-04-02T18:12:04Z] enrich: webhook accepted 202 id=hook_z9
[2026-04-02T18:35:08Z] assign: round_robin deferred (waiting enrich.score)
```
That's 23m unowned.
Maya: This matches the pattern from last quarter. Suggestion: add a short-lived fallback gate. If enrich pending longer than connector.enrich_timeout (default 300s) then assign to overflow queue and annotate meta.handled_by="enrich_fallback".
Ben: Important: exclude VIPs and partner leads from auto-fallback. Also add an outreach flag to avoid double-contact once enrichment finishes.
Rohit: Proposed implementation: connector config key enrich_timeout_seconds, default 300. Code: 
```
if (lead.enrich_status === 'pending' && now - lead.enrich_started_at > connector.enrich_timeout_seconds) {
  assignToOverflow(lead.id)
  lead.meta.push('enrich_fallback')
}
```
Tara: Need telemetry: counter(enrich_fallback_assigned) and alert if rate > 0.4% of daily inbound. Also track duplicate outreach incidents.
Maya: Playbook update: SDRs should label outreach "enrich-fallback" and pause automated cadences until enrichment complete. We'll add wording to the SDR handbook.
ops-bot: rollout-ticket created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/leadflow/pulls/1688 -> staging -> canary-10% -> prod.
Ben: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 24h, monitor duplicate outreach, median time-to-first-contact, and enrich_fallback rate. Auto rollback thresholds defined in runbook.
Rohit: I'll add unit tests for VIP bypass and SF dedupe.
Tara: Action items: Rohit = PR for logic + tests, Ben = metrics & canary run, Maya = playbook text + comms. Sync 9:30am PT tomorrow.
Maya: I'll ping Sales Ops and post draft to #sales-ops.
Tara: Thanks all. This should reduce long-tail unowned leads and keep handoff SLAs stable. :thumbsup:
